parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: Human-readable description of the {{object}}. e.g. a more detailed description of {{param|Type}}.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: The actual reading value; MUST be a member of the enumeration defined in {{param|ValidValues}}.

parameters.name: LastChange
parameters.description: The date and time when {{param|Value}} has been changed to the current value.

parameters.name: LastContactTime
parameters.description: The date and time in UTC when the {{object}} has received data.

parameters.name: ValidValues
parameters.description: List of valid values reported from the sensor represented by this {{object}}.

object.description: EnumSensor is used to reflect the functionality of a sensor that reports explicit non-continuous values.
